repos_data.description: Get info from any web service or page
Extracts information about web pages, like youtube videos, twitter statuses or blog articles.
Create HTML snippets/embeds from URLs using info from oEmbed, Open Graph, meta tags.

repo_meta_data.description: A Oembed consumer library, that gives you information about urls. It helps you replace urls to youtube or vimeo for example, with their html embed code. It has advanced features like offline support, responsive embeds and caching support.
